scripts.build: npm run build -w @xhs/shared && npm run build -w @xhs/native-host && npm run build -w @xhs/desktop && npm run build -w @xhs/extension
scripts.test: npm run build -w @xhs/shared && vitest run --configLoader runner
scripts.start:desktop: npm run build -w @xhs/shared && npm run build -w @xhs/desktop && npm run start -w @xhs/desktop
scripts.build:extension: npm run build -w @xhs/shared && npm run build -w @xhs/extension
scripts.build:native-host: npm run build -w @xhs/shared && npm run build -w @xhs/native-host
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run package:win -w @xhs/desktop
